notes_for_editor: NRHP nomination not digitised. Most narrative rests on LighthouseFriends and the Friends group (secondary); official reports confirm lens order, 1896-97 works, fog signal 1899, 1922 dwelling. Planting date: Bulletin says Oct 1917, LighthouseFriends says 1927 (contradicted by own text). Lens installation 1891 per LighthouseFriends (Board report only says ordered; one web page says 1901, not used). 1891-92 and 1896-97 volumes bind two reports each; fiscal year not determined. Transfer to state: 2001 (Friends) vs 2002 (LighthouseFriends). Wheeler/Whittemore/O-Ta-Was anecdotes are local tradition, uncited by the Friends. Michigan.gov pages returned 403. Keeper roster from USLHS, no primary check; Albert E. Stridfelt start year printed 1260 in archive. Life-saving station No. 4 is not separate-sited here; may deserve its own record. Checker 2026-10-27: Friends say lens was fifth-order from the start, LighthouseFriends says lamps until 1856 (both stated in story). Board 1891-92 volume entry 1113 confirms 1 Sept 1891 change. Fog-signal distance 5/8 mile (LF) vs a mile (Friends). Lens present status unconfirmed after 2016 removal of the light; lens status removed from facts.
